gaps.reason: A road and a café-hut route; the ride or drive is the way to the Port Hills viewpoints (Gondola, Godley Head) rather than a place in itself.

gaps.name: Cathedral Square

gaps.name: 185 Empty Chairs
gaps.reason: Temporary art installation (Wikivoyage: 'was an art work'); the Earthquake National Memorial is the lasting place.

gaps.name: Site of CTV Building memorial garden

gaps.name: St Michael and All Angels Church
